title: AMC Racing
summary: E-commerce for motorcycle accessories, from the storefront to checkout and store operations.
problem: The store needed connected customer and administrative workflows for products, payments, shipping, orders, and returns.
solution: Developed frontend and backend features for the storefront, checkout integrations, order management, reviews, and returns.
result: Delivered and maintained customer and store workflows across the frontend and backend, including payment and shipping integrations.

title: Teh Poci
summary: Daily sales, recipe-based inventory, and cash records brought together for outlet operations.
problem: Daily recording was spread across Cashflow, Inventory, and Rekap workbooks, with related information entered in separate places.
solution: Connected daily sales, stock usage, cash balances, and reporting in a web application while preserving the existing Excel report structure.
result: Combined daily finance and inventory recording in one workflow, with outlet-specific data and Excel reporting.

title: RailDataHub
summary: Freelance development through Yada Technology on an enterprise data platform.
problem: An existing team platform required ongoing feature delivery and maintenance across data-management and administrative workflows.
solution: Contributed frontend and backend improvements, API integration, debugging, testing, and technical documentation within the project team.
result: Contributed improvements to data-management workflows, activity tracking, and administrative tools in an existing platform.

title: Ruang Main
summary: A browser game platform with eight games, optional accounts, saved progress, and solo rankings.
problem: Players needed a lightweight place to enjoy multiple games directly from the browser without a mandatory install or account.
solution: Built a Vite and TypeScript frontend, ElysiaJS backend, and Supabase data layer, with Google OAuth and Cloudflare deployment.
result: Shipped a public production platform with eight browser games and optional account-based saves and rankings.

title: NEW LOS
summary: Validated financing workflows and partner integrations across proposal, approval, activation, and monitoring.
problem: A financing system with multiple modules and partner integrations needed reliable end-to-end validation before release.
solution: Built test cases from business requirements, ran workflow coverage across key modules, and verified integrations with external systems.
result: Created repeatable manual and integration test coverage for financing workflows and partner systems.

title: Esuite
summary: Extended backend modules for marketing, finance, sales, and service availability in an existing business platform.
problem: Business modules needed ongoing feature delivery and stable maintenance in a large existing application.
solution: Implemented new backend capabilities and maintained existing flows in Golang while supporting testing and debugging.
result: Delivered features across several operational modules while improving bug identification during testing.

title: Workshop Management System
summary: Built inventory-focused workshop features and implemented responsive pages from UI/UX designs.
problem: Workshop operations needed inventory-focused product workflows with a usable web interface for automotive use cases.
solution: Implemented UI screens in React and Next.js, integrated frontend pages with backend services, and aligned delivery to provided designs.
result: Delivered responsive inventory workflows with clean frontend integration for the workshop application.

title: Ordering Platform
summary: Implemented CRUD APIs and responsive interfaces for customer, product, and order management.
problem: An ordering platform needed reliable backend APIs, database structure, and a frontend that could support growing order volume.
solution: Built CRUD APIs with Spring Boot, configured PostgreSQL structures, and integrated a React frontend with backend services.
result: Delivered an end-to-end product foundation for managing customer, product, and order data.

title: NOBU Link & Portal
summary: Maintained and extended payment, notification, and service availability features in a microservice system.
problem: Core payment and notification services required feature work and maintenance inside a distributed backend setup.
solution: Implemented and maintained Java microservice features across bill payment, notifications, and availability flows.
result: Supported stable delivery of core backend features in a production microservice environment.
